cards.name: Breach the Multiverse
cards.oracle_text: Each player mills ten cards. For each player, choose a creature or planeswalker card in that player's graveyard. Put those cards onto the battlefield under your control. Then each creature you control becomes a Phyrexian in addition to its other types.

rulings.comment: The creatures you control will be Phyrexians until they leave the battlefield. Any of them that stops being a creature will also stop being a Phyrexian until it becomes a creature again, if applicable.
The cards you choose can be ones that were just milled or ones that were already in the graveyard.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
